candidates.why: dwg_add_APPID (line 1096) expands to API_ADD_TABLE (src/dwg_api.c:24413) which calls API_ADD_OBJECT/NEW_OBJECT -> dwg_add_object (src/decode.c:5450). That reallocs dwg->object (decode.c:5464) and returns -1 on realloc, invalidating pointers into the pool (decode.c:5445-5446). The returned _obj is a heap calloc'd Dwg_Object_APPID (dwg_api.c:22652) so it survives, but its ->parent chain points into the realloc'd pool; dwg_obj_generic_handlevalue(_obj) at line 1097 walks _obj->parent back to the Dwg_Object (dwg_api.c:21864 -> dwg_obj_generic_to_object) and reads obj->handle.value (21866). If the pool was realloc'd, that parent pointer is stale. Also dwg_add_APPID can return NULL (dwg_api.c:24460) and line 1097 dereferences it without a NULL check.

Dead code (#else branch, not compiled since #if 1 at line 1094), but the pattern is a genuine UAF: dwg_add_object (line 1108) reallocs dwg->object and returns -1 when pointers are invalidated (decode.c:5464-5468). Line 1109 then re-derives obj = &dwg->object[num_objects-1], which is safe, but line 1107 already read dwg->object[...] before the realloc and line 1112/1114 use obj after further potential reallocs. Reported for completeness of the pattern.

Dead code (#else branch). appctl is obtained at lines 1100-1101 from dwg->header_vars.APPID_CONTROL_OBJECT or dwg_find_table_control. dwg_add_object at line 1108 may realloc dwg->object and set dwg->dirty_refs (decode.c:5468), invalidating the cached appctl->obj pointer. Line 1118 reads appctl->absolute_ref and line 1126 passes appctl to dwg_ref_object, which trusts ref->obj when !dwg->dirty_refs (src/dwg.c:775-776) — a stale cached obj would be returned and then dereferenced at line 1132 (obj->tio.object->tio.APPID_CONTROL).

Dead code (#else branch). After dwg_add_object at line 1108 reallocs the pool, dwg_ref_object at line 1126 may return a stale cached ref->obj (src/dwg.c:775-776 returns ref->obj without re-resolving when dirty_refs is clear). Line 1132 then dereferences obj->tio.object->tio.APPID_CONTROL and line 1133 PUSH_HV writes through it — a write into freed/realloc'd memory.
